comparison.name: Boel author-structure train-refit versus RK23 base-plus-UH
comparison.author_codon_features: all 61 sense-codon relative frequencies except ATG; named cf_<CODON>; lexical DNA codon order
comparison.reason_published_coefficients_not_used: They were fitted on all E0/E5 rows, including the present dev/test proteins; using them would leak evaluation labels.

author_feature_definitions.tag_and_stop: Remove the terminal stop and the exact C-terminal LEHHHHHH tag (24 nt) before every author-model calculation.
author_feature_definitions.codon_frequency: Sense-codon count divided by the number of core codons. ATG is omitted only from the final 60 global codon columns.
author_feature_definitions.single_codon_slopes: For each of 61 sense codons, fit an unregularized binary logistic E5 versus E0 model on train extremes only using its global core-CDS frequency; retain the raw-frequency slope. Internal ATG is included for regional slopes.
author_feature_definitions.s7_16: Mean train-only single-codon slope over observed codons 7 through 16 inclusive.
author_feature_definitions.s17_32: Mean train-only single-codon slope over observed codons 17 through 32 inclusive.
author_feature_definitions.head_composition: Codons 2-6: aH and gH are A/G fractions over all 15 nt; u3H is the T fraction over the five third positions.
author_feature_definitions.I_62: 1 iff source_Gz48v < -39 kcal/mol and GC over codons 2-6 > 0.62, else 0.
author_feature_definitions.I_threshold_discrepancy: Main equation/Methods use 62%; Extended Data Fig.3 text contains 65%. Both produce 558 identical positive rows in this dataset, so the discrepancy is numerically immaterial; 62% is primary.
author_feature_definitions.dAUA: 1 iff at least one adjacent in-frame ATA-ATA di-codon occurs in the core CDS.
author_feature_definitions.rAA: Amino-acid repetition rate: mean over core residues of reciprocal distance to the next identical amino acid; no downstream recurrence contributes 0.
author_feature_definitions.length_scaling: L_knt = core CDS nucleotide length / 1000; Linv_knt = 1000 / core CDS nucleotide length. These recover the published -0.0012 L_nt and -520/L_nt terms up to refitting.
author_feature_definitions.regional_slope_identifiability: Single-variable slopes are fitted before the final model and frozen; final multivariate codon coefficients are not recycled into the regional features.

single_codon_binary.standardization: train mean/std for optimization; slope transformed back to raw frequency

models.selection: fixed a priori; no hyperparameter search and no dev/test-based model selection

endpoint_signs: Positive always favors author-structure over base-plus-UH: AUC author-base; log-loss base-author; Spearman author-base; MSE base-author.
binary_evaluation: Only E0/E5 rows within each evaluation split; probability of E5 is scored by ROC AUC and binary log-loss.
multiclass_evaluation: All E0-E5 rows; expected score is scored by Spearman and MSE.
resampling_details: Binary and multiclass tracks draw independent cluster samples from their respective eligible rows using separate fixed RNG calls. All four endpoints use the same replicate index within each track.
multiple_testing: Holm across exactly four primary endpoints within each split.
primary_pass_rule: An endpoint passes iff effect>0, bootstrap 95% CI lower bound>0, and Holm p<0.05. Broad author-structure superiority requires all four; otherwise the corresponding superiority claim remains unsupported.
dev_role: One frozen dev evaluation and independent reproduction before test. Dev is not used to tune features, thresholds, regularization, or model choices.
test_role: One confirmation-gated reuse of the RK23 test after dev independent verification; not globally untouched.
scientific_scope: Protein-cluster OOD comparison on cross-protein, non-synonymous Boel ordinal expression scores. It tests predictive value of the author feature/model structure, not fixed-protein synonymous causality, translation velocity, mRNA decay, or the complete spatial-coupling mechanism.
prohibited_claims: No use of published full-data coefficients as an OOD predictor.
No claim of exact reproduction of the original fitted coefficients or an external untouched benchmark.
No claim that a predictive baseline improvement proves translation velocity, mRNA decay, causality, or fixed-protein synonymous optimization.
No claim of CodonFlow-RK superiority, time-matched superiority, complete seven-method ranking, or generator authorization from this baseline alone.
